```plato

//==
// # Metaballs
//
// Smooth organic shapes from summed radial falloff kernels
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Metaballs). The implicit surface is the level
// set (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Level_set) where the summed influence
// equals the threshold. The falloff kernel and the summation live in
// `fields-implicits.library.plato`.

// A planar metaball: a radial falloff kernel centered at a point. Influence
// is Strength at the center and falls to zero at Radius.
type MetaBall2D
    implements IValue
{
    Center: Point2D;
    Radius: Number;
    Strength: Number;
}
```
